evals.name: functional-test
evals.prompt: Run functional tests on the Astro project at template/astro-project/. Start dev server, visit index page, check for console errors, verify page loads with content. Save test-report.json.
evals.expected_output: test-report.json with index page results showing: httpStatus 200, no consoleErrors, hasContent true, passed true.

assertions.name: has-pages
assertions.check: Report has 'pages' array with test results

assertions.name: page-tested
assertions.check: Index page was tested and has results

evals.name: quality-evaluation
evals.prompt: Evaluate visual quality of the generated homepage at template/astro-project/src/pages/index.astro. Take screenshot and score each dimension (layoutConsistency, designTokenUsage, componentComposition, responsiveDesign, semanticHTML, visualAppeal). Save as quality-scores.json.
evals.expected_output: quality-scores.json with scores for each dimension (1-10 scale) and overallScore calculated. Should include feedback comments.

assertions.name: has-scores
assertions.check: Report has 'scores' object with all 6 dimensions

evals.name: responsive-check
evals.prompt: Test responsive design of the homepage. Check at mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1920px) viewports. Report any issues in quality-scores.json under responsiveDesign score.
evals.expected_output: quality-scores.json with responsiveDesign score and comments about any responsive issues found.

assertions.name: viewport-tested
assertions.check: Feedback mentions testing at multiple viewports
